QUOTE: Tests in `tests/suites/test_suite_constant_time.function` use `TEST_CF_SECRET` and `TEST_CF_PUBLIC` annotations. Under Valgrind or MSan these mark secret memory as undefined... The two opt-in switches, `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`, are off by default in `mbedtls_config.h`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says verification is test-time via MSan/Valgrind, opt-in and off by default. It also says only `mbedtls_ct_memcmp` is public API and the rest is internal, which covers the not-part-of-the-library-API point.
